active_skus.description: Business terms related to This domain represents all SKUs (stock keeping units) currently considered 'active' in the warehouse or inventory system. The terms MTD (Month to Date) and YTD (Year to Date) refer to inventory activity or SKU counts within the current month or year, commonly used for performance tracking, supply planning, and operational reporting.

It also supports cartonization grouping via batch IDs, enabling precise tracking of how items are picked and packed for outbound fulfillment. transaction_and_system_integration.description: Terms used to describe how the t_system table is referenced by transactional or operational tables to link records to specific systems or sites.

system_validation_and_control.description: Terms related to enforcing data integrity in the t_system table, including constraints that ensure valid system identifiers and prevent incorrect data entry.

label_management.description: Terms related to managing individual labels generated for warehouse picking operations. These labels are tracked by status, associated pick tasks, and print sequence. The data helps ensure correct printing, usage, and lifecycle tracking of each label.

pick_label_linkage.description: Terms describing how labels are tied to specific pick tasks. This linkage ensures that the right labels are generated and tracked per picking operation.

process_linking_and_execution.description: Terms referring to how menu items are associated with backend processes or system functions. This linkage ensures that selecting a menu item results in executing the correct underlying business logic.

ui_display_configuration.description: Terms used to configure how menu items appear in the UI, including display text and order. These attributes define user-facing labels and the order of appearance to create a coherent user experience.

carrier_menu_extension.description: Terms describing the logical extension of the carrier master data into the menu system. Menu items can be used to group or expose carrier-related functions in K.Motion Ship or Warehouse Advantage interfaces.

adapter_and_integration_ui.description: Terms related to how the menu structure supports integrations between Warehouse Advantage, Flagship, and K.Motion Ship. Menus help drive dynamic configuration of adapter UIs without requiring code changes.

country_master_data.description: Terms related to the master list of countries maintained in the system, providing standardized country identifiers, full names, and abbreviations used across transactional and master data tables for consistent country referencing.

shipping_and_logistics_country_reference.description: Terms describing the use of country data for shipping and logistics purposes, including documentation, address validation, and destination or origin country designation to ensure accuracy in transportation and customs processes.

address_and_location_country_reference.description: Terms related to associating country data with physical addresses of customers, vendors, warehouses, and operational sites, providing validation and standardization of location information across the system.

region_master_data.description: Terms related to the master list of regions maintained in the system, providing standardized region identifiers, names, and abbreviations linked to countries, ensuring consistent regional referencing across transactional and master data processes.

order_import_region_mapping.description: Terms describing the use of region master data during order import processes to validate, map, and standardize region information from external sources to system-recognized regional entities.

address_and_location_region_reference.description: Terms related to associating region data with physical addresses for customers, vendors, warehouses, and operational sites, supporting address validation and geographic segmentation within the system.

locale_date_format_configuration.description: Terms related to the configuration of date display formats per locale, specifying how dates are rendered in user interfaces and reports according to regional or language-specific conventions. These formats support localization and internationalization to ensure users view dates in a familiar and expected way.

localization_and_internationalization.description: Terms emphasizing the role of locale date formats in broader localization and internationalization efforts, ensuring software adapts to diverse regional preferences and language settings.

pick_area_configuration.description: Terms related to defining discrete picking zones within a warehouse to optimize material flow, labor allocation, and task execution during order picking.

warehouse_and_container_references.description: Terms focusing on the relationships between pick areas, warehouses, and container classifications, supporting logical links to warehouse master data and container configuration for consistent operational context.

operational_parameters_and_workload.description: Terms describing operational settings used to balance workload, assign work types, and define container classes within specific pick areas to drive efficient warehouse operations.

t_full_floor_denial.description: Business terms related to tracking full order denials or cancellations at the warehouse level, used for audit, reporting, and performance analysis when orders cannot be fulfilled due to operational constraints such as stockouts, capacity limitations, or system issues.

employee_productivity_standards.description: Business terms related to storing employee-specific productivity standards and performance benchmarks by transaction type to support labor management, performance evaluation, and labor planning.

units_of_measure.description: Business terms related to defining and managing standardized units of measure used across warehouse and enterprise systems to ensure consistent measurement, quantity validation, and integration with procurement, inventory, and shipping processes.

kship_shipment_header.description: Business terms related to managing outbound shipment header information that links orders to carriers, supports freight cost tracking, label generation, shipment tracing, and audit compliance in the warehouse and logistics environment.

invoice_line_detail.description: Business terms related to detailed line-level invoice data capturing item quantities, prices, and billing information to support accurate invoicing, financial posting, revenue tracking, and order reconciliation processes.

t_invoice.description: Business terms related to the generation, tracking, and reporting of customer invoices for fulfilled orders, capturing key financial, shipping, and customer details that support the order-to-cash process, financial reconciliation, customer service, and audit compliance.

wave_order_detail.description: Terms related to the detailed tracking and sequencing of orders within a wave in warehouse wave picking operations...

wave_master_data.description: Terms related to the high-level configuration and management of waves in the warehouse system...

kit_unpick_identification.description: Terms related to the unique identification of each unpick record within the kit picking process in the warehouse.

temporal_information.description: Terms related to the date and time details associated with the creation and transaction of kit unpick actions.

warehouse_context.description: Terms defining the warehouse context where the kit unpick action took place.

order_reference.description: Terms related to the identification of the order associated with the unpick action.

order_line_details.description: Terms defining the specific line within an order related to the unpicked kit item.

item_information.description: Terms relating to the item being unpicked from the kit during the picking process.

quantity_metrics.description: Terms related to various quantity measurements tracked during the kit pick and unpick process...

handling_unit_details.description: Terms associated with the handling unit involved in the kit picking and unpicking process.

location_and_container.description: Terms defining the physical location and container related to the pick and unpick actions in the warehouse.

user_and_operation.description: Terms related to the user or operator who performed the unpick action.

kit_status_tracking.description: Terms describing the status of the kit pick or unpick process, such as completed or short pick.

customer_identification.description: Terms related to the unique identification of individual customers in the system.

customer_personal_information.description: Terms describing the name or designation of the customer.

customer_address.description: Terms related to the physical address of the customer including multiple address lines.

customer_geographical_info.description: Terms associated with geographical location attributes of the customer.

customer_country_info.description: Terms describing the country identification of the customer.

customer_contact_details.description: Terms related to contact information for communicating with the customer.

customer_segmentation.description: Terms describing customer classification used for segmentation, prioritization, or loyalty programs.

shipping_and_delivery_preferences.description: Terms related to customer preferences for shipping and delivery.

warehouse_association.description: Terms indicating association of customers with specific warehouses for fulfillment or operational context.

additional_attributes.description: Additional optional attributes capturing specific operational or business flags related to the customer.

manifest_station_configuration.description: Terms related to the configuration of manifest stations within warehouses, including the assignment of printer IDs for shipping operations.

warehouse_mapping.description: Terms describing the connection between a manifest station and the warehouse it belongs to.

printer_assignment.description: Terms representing the assignment of printers for various document types including packing labels, shipping labels, invoices, and returns.

shipping_workflow_support.description: Terms describing how the table supports shipping and packing workflows by directing documents to the correct printers.

operational_reference_data.description: Terms identifying the table as part of reference or configuration data rather than transactional data for shipping or order processing.

error_and_risk_mitigation.description: Terms related to the risks and errors that may occur if data in the manifest station table is missing or incorrect.

robot_event_tracking.description: Terms related to the tracking and recording of individual events or updates from robots during warehouse operations.

robot_job_management.description: Terms associated with how robots relate to assigned jobs, including tracking job identifiers and their execution dates.

order_and_handling_unit.description: Terms dealing with how robot events are tied to specific orders and handling units, ensuring traceability of physical operations.

robot_performance_and_diagnostics.description: Terms used for analyzing robot performance, identifying inefficiencies, diagnosing failures, and improving overall robotic operations.

audit_and_monitoring.description: Terms related to auditing robot activities and using log data for compliance, monitoring, and visibility.

log_structure_and_identity.description: Terms related to how individual log entries are uniquely identified and structured for relational integrity and analysis.

robot_identity.description: Terms associated with identifying which robot generated a specific event or report.

robot_job_queue_management.description: Terms related to the queuing, identification, and dispatching of robot jobs for warehouse automation workflows.

message_handling_and_integration.description: Terms describing the messaging mechanism used between the warehouse management system and robotic systems for task coordination.

warehouse_and_work_queue_context.description: Terms that define the context of a robot job within the warehouse and the originating work queue or order.

job_status_and_lifecycle.description: Terms related to the status and timestamps that define each stage of a robot job's lifecycle, from insertion to completion or failure.

error_and_output_logging.description: Terms related to capturing the result of robot job execution and logging any errors or issues that occurred.

robot_and_item_identification.description: Terms used for identifying the robot involved in the job and the item being handled during task execution.

location_and_cart_tracking.description: Terms related to the physical warehouse context of the robot job, including the assigned storage location and cart used during movement.

exception_handling_and_audit.description: Terms related to identifying and analyzing job failures or exceptions, and supporting audits of robot operations in the warehouse.
